title: Top view of my mall
content: Its not even close to perfect but this as close as I could get it using ai. The terrain around the mall is far more unpredictable with lots of height variations like sudden cliffs. And the roads dont look like that either. The roads that get you around the outside of the mall should be more like overpasses, raised up off and away from the attractions on the ground and a lot fewer roads. The parkings lots are sometimes raised off the ground as well. Also not as many skyscrapers but maybe a couple including the hotel. I havent gotten to know most of the places so this is my best take on it.
